BJP claims J&K achieved freedom and development post-Article 370 abrogation

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) president stated that the people of Jammu and Kashmir (J&K) have achieved true freedom following the abrogation of Article 370. Prime Minister Modi linked the abrogation to the vision of Syama Prasad Mookerjee. The party asserts that J&K is now recognized for its development and peace.
